system.description:
Required Weapon: Sword & Main Gauche A Vodacce style created by the famed courtesan Veronica Ambrogia. Fought with the sword in the left hand and main gauche in the right, it emphasizes using any means to win.

  • Temptress’s Guile. You add your Charm to damage rolls.
  • Choice Words. During a combat scene, you may mark any amount of Stress to force your adversary to mark 2 Stress for every Stress you marked.
  • Kiss of Death. If your foe is infatuated with you or made jealous, clear a Stress after successfully attacking them.
